_comment: Hong Kong entity (SetID 36000 / BU 36120) expense-type chart + AU->HK mapping. Read from EXPENSE_TYPE$0 options live on 2026-07-20; verify with PS.dumpExpenseTypes() as it can drift. See docs/HK-MODULE.md.

auToHkNotes.TAXIINT: HK has no international taxi variant; all ground transport is GRNDTRN.
auToHkNotes.MEALINC: HK has no international client-meal variant; use MEAL50.
auToHkNotes.SUBSIST: HK has no subsistence type; solo travel meals -> MEAL100 (employee), you are auto-added as attendee.
auToHkNotes.LIGHTRE: MEAL100 for refreshments; if the line is really a visa/fee (check description), use OTHTAX.
auToHkNotes.TRAVOTH: Visa / tourist levy / travel fees -> OTHTAX. TRVL exists but is 'GWS ONLY' and usually invalid for non-GWS staff.
auToHkNotes.EMPRELC: Needs authorising contract attached before submit.
